items.title: Carmen Caramanica interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, July 27, 2011
items.q: playing with you and Rick [Montalbano] and Dolores [Mancuso], and I forget the drummer’s name. Joe DePalma.

ctx.x: And I have to tell you that my graduate school, after I got out of Fredonia, was playing with you and Rick [Montalbano] and Dolores [Mancuso], and I forget the drummer’s name.
Joe DePalma. Of course he was Joey Dee, right?
